entries.name: John R. Washington

expected.charges: Breach of the peace — Freedom Ride test of the Jackson Municipal Airport facilities, July 21, 1961.
expected.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record
expected.sentence: Arrested 1961-07-21. The Civil Rights Digital Library establishes the arrest and the identification photograph but not the disposition, any transfer to Parchman, or the release date — unresolved pending court, jail, or penitentiary records.

updates.sentence: Jailed following the July 21, 1961 Jackson airport protest. Individual release date and final court disposition remain unresolved.

entries.rationale: Arsenault roster pp570-571 identifies the nine airport participants; Sellers firsthand memoir vol2 pp2-3 confirms immediate jailing of that group. Do not generalize his overnight release to every member.

updates.sentence: Jailed after the July 21, 1961 airport protest; released in July. Accounts differ on duration, so an exact release day remains unresolved.

entries.rationale: Arsenault roster pp570-571 identifies the nine airport participants; Sellers firsthand memoir vol2 pp2-3 confirms immediate jailing of that group. Do not generalize his overnight release to every member. Sonoma County Peace Press Aug/Sep2021 p1 reproduces obituary reporting both Jorgensens served one week, differing from Sellers general overnight account. Both support July release, neither supports40days. Preserve uncertainty rather than assert exact duration.
